svg.title: Before and after: retention of failed and undeployed web build pairs on QuantVPS
svg.desc: Before, the prune kept the newest 10 backup pairs and never deleted failed or undeployed pairs. After, it also keeps the newest 2 failed and the newest 2 undeployed pairs and deletes older ones, at most 3 pairs per run in total.
svg.text: all kept: 0 pairs over the keep counts today
